boards.school_name: State University of New York at New Paltz
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented SUNY New Paltz study environments, with room rules and access details called out where published.

cards.entity_name: Sojourner Truth Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Sojourner Truth Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Main Floor, Sojourner Truth Library
cards.notes: Book ahead for a project session: each room has a whiteboard, table power, built-in PC, large touchscreen display, and laptop connections.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, technology-equipped space for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has group rooms on its Main Floor; bookings are required, groups need two or more people, and each booking may be up to one hour per patron per day.
cards.source_title: Library Study Room Policy – SUNY New Paltz Library
cards.access_notes: For current SUNY New Paltz students with valid ID. Book through the library system; groups of two or more receive priority.

cards.entity_name: Sojourner Truth Library Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Sojourner Truth Library Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Concourse and Ground Floor, Sojourner Truth Library
cards.notes: Choose this for a solo block of work: check out a room key at the Checkout Desk and return it there when you finish.
cards.short_summary: Keyed, one-person rooms for focused individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Individual study rooms are for one person, located on the Concourse and Ground Floor, and available first come, first served; four rooms have four-hour use and two have 12-hour use.
cards.source_title: Library Study Room Policy – SUNY New Paltz Library
cards.access_notes: Current SUNY New Paltz students with valid ID only. A key is checked out to one borrower and may not be shared.

cards.entity_name: Sojourner Truth Library Main Floor Public PCs
cards.title: Main Floor Public PCs
cards.subtitle: Sojourner Truth Library Main Floor
cards.notes: Use a numbered public workstation for research or academic work, then note its number if you need to report a technical problem.
cards.short_summary: Library workstations with academic and research software.
cards.evidence_claim: The library provides 74 public PCs on the Main Floor primarily for research and academic work, with Microsoft Office 365 and other listed software.
cards.source_title: Library Public PCs – SUNY New Paltz Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the library Main Floor. The library also supports guest and faculty logins.

cards.title: Reference Collection Tables
cards.subtitle: Main Floor, Sojourner Truth Library
cards.notes: Bring a research question and work beside reference materials such as encyclopedias, dictionaries, and handbooks on the Main Floor.
cards.short_summary: A research-oriented setting beside the library’s reference collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Sojourner Truth Library’s Reference Collection is on the Main Floor and includes encyclopedias, dictionaries, and handbooks.
cards.source_title: Library Collections and Call Numbers – SUNY New Paltz Library
cards.access_notes: The collection is listed on the Main Floor; consult the Front Desk or Research Help for assistance.

cards.title: Current Periodicals & Zines
cards.subtitle: Main Floor, Sojourner Truth Library
cards.notes: Settle in with current periodicals or browse the zines before drafting; both collections are listed together on the Main Floor directory.
cards.short_summary: A browsing-oriented library area for periodicals and zines.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s Main Floor directory lists Current Periodicals & Zines among the floor’s destinations.
cards.source_title: Library Map and Directory – SUNY New Paltz Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the Main Floor of Sojourner Truth Library; library building hours are published by Facilities.

cards.title: Create Space
cards.subtitle: Sojourner Truth Library
cards.notes: Use this library area when a project benefits from hands-on making; confirm available materials or equipment with library staff before planning.
cards.short_summary: A library making space with craft supplies and sewing machines.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s published facts sheet states that Create Space is equipped with craft supplies and sewing machines.
cards.access_notes: Located in Sojourner Truth Library; ask library staff about current equipment availability and use procedures.

cards.title: Faculty Study Room
cards.subtitle: Main Floor, Sojourner Truth Library
cards.notes: Faculty members can use this distinct Main Floor study room; students should select another library space unless staff confirm access.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study room listed in the library’s Main Floor directory.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sojourner Truth Library Main Floor directory lists a Faculty Study Room.
cards.source_title: Library Map and Directory – SUNY New Paltz Library
cards.access_notes: Faculty-oriented space; the public directory does not publish student access rules.

cards.title: Student Union 100 South / Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Student Union
cards.notes: Use the individual or group study tables between classes; commuters have a lounge designed for them, with charging stations and microwaves nearby.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor lounge with study tables and practical commuter amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Union’s Commuter Lounge is on the first floor and has tables for studying, charging stations, and microwaves; its policy describes individual and group study tables.
cards.source_title: Fast Facts for Students Living Off-Campus – SUNY New Paltz
cards.access_notes: Primarily designed for commuter students. Student groups may reserve it after 8 p.m. on weekdays and during Student Union operating hours on weekends.

cards.title: Student Union Third-Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, Student Union
cards.notes: Use the refurbished third-floor lounge as an open campus setting, and check the Union directory or staff desk for any event-related availability.
cards.short_summary: A refurbished lounge alongside student-organization and cultural spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz reported that the renovated Student Union third floor includes a refurbished lounge and revamped meeting areas.
cards.source_title: Celebrating the new-and-improved Student Union – SUNY New Paltz News
cards.access_notes: Inside the Student Union. Published building hours list weekday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday operating windows; event use may affect availability.

cards.title: Library Classroom
cards.subtitle: Concourse Level, Sojourner Truth Library
cards.notes: Locate this teaching space from the Main Floor stairs by the gallery or the concourse entrance hallway, then verify availability before use.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed library classroom near the Lecture Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The library directory identifies the Library Classroom and gives directions from both the Main Floor and concourse entrance, placing it before the Lecture Center.
cards.source_title: Library Map and Directory – SUNY New Paltz Library
cards.access_notes: This is a classroom; availability for independent study is not published and should be confirmed before entering or using it.
